about: Brand notes: general positioning (style, typical price, what the brand's catalog carries), not reviews of any particular store. Price tiers: 1 = mostly under $50, 2 = $50–150, 3 = $150–400, 4 = $400+ for a typical item. 'strict' brands only match shop names that are the brand name plus location words, because the name is a common word.

brands.name: Uniqlo
brands.blurb: Japanese basics: HEATTECH, AIRism, fleece, ultra light down, knitwear.

brands.name: Zara
brands.blurb: Runway-inspired trends with new pieces arriving constantly.

brands.name: H&M
brands.blurb: Low-priced trends and basics for everyone.

brands.name: Mango
brands.blurb: Spanish label: polished trends, tailoring and knits.

brands.name: COS
brands.blurb: Architectural minimalism: clean knits, shirting and tailoring.

brands.name: & Other Stories
brands.blurb: Feminine, detail-driven pieces, shoes and jewelry.

brands.name: Urban Outfitters
brands.blurb: Gen-Z trends and brands, plus reworked and vintage (Urban Renewal).
